value.name: sit down at laptop
value.description: She sits down in front of the laptop to carry out the transfer.
evidence: sat down in front of the laptop

value.name: enter full deposit amount
value.description: She types the full deposit amount into the transfer field.
evidence: She typed the full deposit into the field

value.name: authorize wire transfer
value.description: She reviews the amount and authorizes the wire to Bridgepoint without adding a memo.
evidence: read it back once, and authorized the wire to Bridgepoint without writing anything in the memo line

value.name: ignore confirmation reference
value.description: She sees the confirmation reference number but does not copy it down.
evidence: The confirmation screen came up with a reference number she did not bother to copy down

value.name: realize savings are committed
value.description: She realizes that four years of untouched savings have now been committed to the next phase of her life.
evidence: she understood, sitting there with the rate sheet under her wrist, that the four years of untouched savings had just become the shape of the next part of her life

value.name: accept Marcus's share as fixed
value.description: She decides Marcus's half is now just a number she will carry without discussing it again.
evidence: Marcus's half was now a number she would carry without asking him about again
